environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind CloudFront distribution (d1234abcdef.cloudfront.net) with origin-facing ALB. CloudFront distribution has a response headers policy (ID: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) that injects Content-Security-Policy with script-src directive requiring SRI hashes. Specifically, the managed response headers policy 'SecurityHeadersPolicy' is customized with: script-src 'self' 'sha384-oqVuAfXRKap7fdgcCY5uykM6+R9GqQ8K/uxy9rx7HNQlGYl1kPzQho1wx4JwY8wC' 'sha384-Li9vy3DqF8tnTXuiaAJuML3ky+er10rcgNR/VqsVpcw+ThHmYcwiB1pbOxEb2V2I'. The CloudFront function at viewer-response stage also strips any cdn query parameter from requests before forwarding to origin, using a CloudFront Function (runtime: cloudfront-js-1.0) that performs URL sanitization. The ECS task role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/BoundaryNoExec) that denies iot:UpdateThingShadow and ssm:SendCommand. VPC security group restricts inbound to CloudFront managed prefix list only.

config.response_headers_policy: custom SecurityHeadersPolicy with CSP script-src requiring SRI sha384 hashes
config.cloudfront_function: viewer-request stage strips 'cdn' query parameter, normalizes URL path
config.network: private subnet, SG inbound from com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing prefix list only
